request: Build a small Jac web app for a people records system. A visitor can create a record with name, email, age and gender, see all records in a table, edit any field of a record, and delete a record. Reject an email without '@' and an age outside 5-130 with a visible error. Keep the record rules in a reusable service.
acceptance: Creating, listing, editing and deleting records works through the service and the page.
An email without '@' or an age outside 5-130 is rejected and nothing is stored.
constraints: Use Jac 0.36.1 and a fullstack Jac app.
Keep the logic deterministic and independent of external APIs.

source.note: Requirements paraphrased in English from the repository README/description; no code copied.
